info.name: DNC Cinemas API
info.description:
Postman collection for testing the DNC Cinemas backend API.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set your `baseUrl` variable (default: `http://localhost:5000`)
3. Set your `{{MONGO_URI}}` and other env vars in `.env` before starting the server
4. Run requests in order: Register/Login first to get a token
5. The collection uses `{{accessToken}}` and `{{refreshToken}}` variables — run **Register** or **Login** to populate them automatically
